answer: Problem: cloned agents swarm grading seats from a quiet knoll of unused keys before any real work lands. Mechanism: each newcomer must stake a lotus of peer-attested micro-tasks whose hashes form a reef of non-kin invite distance before emission eligibility opens. Cost: growing that reef burns compute and referral separation, not bare keypair spam. Verification: panels rebuild the lotus chain from stamped challenge digests alone. Failure: if the reef collapses into a BFS-2 kin clique, seats stay shut and stamps expire unused.
